test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_bf_select (j JSON(tags Array(String))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity_bytes = 0
ALTER TABLE json_bf_select ADD INDEX bf_full j TYPE jsonbf_v1() GRANULARITY 1
ALTER TABLE json_bf_select ADD INDEX bf_narrow j TYPE jsonbf_v1(include_paths = ['id', 'request_id', 'tags']) GRANULARITY 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_bf_select SELECT ('{{"id":' || toString(number) || ',"request_id":"req-' || toString(number) || '","tenant":"tenant-' || toString(number % 100) || '","tags":["tag-' || toString(number) || '","common"],' || arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> '"payload' || toString(i) || '":"' || toString(cityHash64(number + i)) || '"', range(12)), ',') || '}}')::JSON(tags Array(String)) FROM numbers(1000000)
